key_findings: FKBP51 inhibitor SAFit2 reduced SNI-induced mechanical hypersensitivity, DRG/spinal cytokines and chemokines, NF-kB activation and immune cell infiltration.
SAFit2 desensitizes TRPV1 (FKBP51-independent, not direct channel block) and reduces capsaicin-evoked CGRP release.
